meta.title: Python KD-tree 3D demonstration
meta.buildTraversal: preorder: root, left subtree, right subtree
meta.rangeResultOrder: traversal order from range_report; no ID ordering guarantee
meta.rangeEventIds: prune_disjoint and accept_subtree expose sorted full-subtree IDs in ids and subtreeIds
meta.nearestTieBreak: smallest squared distance, then point id
meta.dynamicTreeSnapshots: Every dynamic step includes complete plainTree and balancedTree snapshots.
meta.benchmarkNotice: All timing and visited-node values were measured on generation; rerun and compare using the same environment.

metadata.timing_statistic: median of 3 repeated full query batches, reported per query
metadata.visited_nodes_method: recorded in a separate trace-enabled pass; tracing is excluded from timed query batches
metadata.range_timing_scope: KD-tree and brute-force timings both include result-list materialisation but neither sorts result IDs

range_volume_fraction.note: Each dimension's side length is volume_fraction**(1/d), subject to the [0,1]^d domain.

metadata.seed_policy: fixed seeds per case for reproducible datasets and queries; wall-clock timings still vary by run
